import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { diaryEntries } from "./diary_entries";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "code" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "english_name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "native_name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const languages = defineTable("languages", {
    columns: {
        code: col.text().primaryKey(),
        englishName: col.text().notNull(),
        nativeName: col.text()
    },
    relations: {
        diary_entries: rel.hasMany(() => diaryEntries, { foreignKey: "language_code" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
